strings.name: Sergey Brin
strings.role: Google co-founder · Search and artificial intelligence
strings.summary: Sergey Brin researched web search with Larry Page at Stanford and co-founded Google. He helped develop its search business and technology projects, later serving as Alphabet president. After leaving executive duties in 2019, he remained a director and returned to AI research in 2023.
strings.coverageNote: Sources checked through 13 November 2026; selected milestones extend to 2026, not an exhaustive news record. Institutional achievements are team efforts; announced plans are not completed results.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founded Google and advanced search algorithms and internet products, influencing global knowledge retrieval and technology entrepreneurship.
strings.facts.fact-1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.fact-2.label: Education
strings.facts.fact-2.value: Maryland BS in mathematics and computer science, 1993; Stanford computer science MS, 1995
strings.highlights.highlight-1.title: Web search
strings.highlights.highlight-1.text: With Page, developed a research search system into a global information-retrieval service.
strings.highlights.highlight-2.title: Technology organizations
strings.highlights.highlight-2.text: Helped develop Google and Alphabet and later returned to AI projects.
strings.timeline.event-1.title: Science advisory appointment
strings.timeline.event-1.text: The White House announced his appointment to the President’s science and technology advisory council.
strings.timeline.event-2.title: Returned to AI work
strings.timeline.event-2.text: Re-engaged with technical work at Google on artificial-intelligence projects.
strings.timeline.event-3.title: Left Alphabet presidency
strings.timeline.event-3.text: With Page, stepped back from executive duties while remaining a co-founder and director.
strings.timeline.event-4.title: Alphabet restructuring
strings.timeline.event-4.text: Became president of the new parent company, with Google as a subsidiary.
strings.timeline.event-5.title: Google went public
strings.timeline.event-5.text: The company he co-founded completed its initial public offering.
strings.timeline.event-6.title: Co-founded Google
strings.timeline.event-6.text: Turned Stanford search research into a company with Page.
strings.timeline.event-7.title: Stanford master’s degree
strings.timeline.event-7.text: Earned a computer science master’s and began collaborating with Page.
strings.timeline.event-8.title: Maryland graduation
strings.timeline.event-8.text: Earned a mathematics and computer science bachelor’s before graduate work at Stanford.
strings.timeline.event-9.title: Moved to the United States
strings.timeline.event-9.text: Emigrated from the Soviet Union with his family at age six.
strings.timeline.event-10.title: Born in Moscow
strings.timeline.event-10.text: Born into a family involved in mathematics.
